verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LM Studio serves local models on OpenAI-like endpoints with completions, chat completions, embeddings and structured outputs, and that MCP servers can be used with local models inside the app. Nothing documents tool or function calling in API requests, or any reasoning-parser support, so this applicable serving-API capability is unevidenced. The in-app MCP integration is a client-side chat feature and does not show request-level tool calling.
